claims.scope: Degree-6 additive MBE made no strict joint false decision in the current generic conditional-null grid.

Degrees 1-3 gained observed-design power but reached 100% false support in at least one generic proxy cell; degree 6 controlled those proxies while the interaction family remained underpowered at 36 configurations.
Final training loss is increment-supported in zero of 24 frozen PGDL metadata-floor fits.
The public Dziugaite source statistic matches its externally visible Figure 1 checks.
In the current 20-repetition refit grid, three null/proxy scenarios had zero strict support and the genuine increment had complete recovery.
Across 6,400 null/proxy rows, predictive false support was 0.25% and joint false support was 0.125%; all 1,600 injected-signal rows had predictive support.
All 1,000 paired 499-draw predictive decisions agreed with the 999-draw reference in the frozen convergence study.

Across 9,600 known-truth datasets and 153,600 method rows, no tested procedure combined strict worst-cell null control with useful worst-cell beta-0.50 power at 24 and 48 independent configurations. This is a finite-design frontier, not a universal ranking.
Across 10,080 fresh known-truth rows, no 3- or 5-split intersection candidate achieved both at most 5% worst null/proxy support and at least 50% weakest effect-0.50 support.
